baseline.protection_evidence: Public, origin, and local main matched at a0d2340 with both workflows green before the correction.
baseline.selection_reason: This is the protected public release that rollback must preserve.

resources: GitHub EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER main, repository variables, repository secrets, and Actions
Isolated Z-drive Codex homes and the installed local Codex integration
semantic_changes: Bundle and locally install EKG SpecSwarm, governance, adaptive execution, and Plotkeeper guard components.
Bundle exact Slopware MSW, MSW Hook, and Timebox packages with original attribution and license.
Bind release verification to this final contract.
Correct only the documented pre-push comparison and rollback target to the protected public baseline a0d23403f9b3d0cab13e8f3ea0a695bc17826018.
Do not alter runtime behavior, UI, package metadata, public license, or weaken enforcement.
Do not include secrets, caches, bytecode, personal data, machine receipts, or calibration history.
Do not change rollback mechanics beyond correcting the protected SHA and comparison baseline.

invariants: A clean isolated installation supplies every skill-code dependency without downloading skill code.
Platform capabilities are named separately and never misrepresented as vendored code.
Rollback preserves the a0d2340 public baseline and uses force-with-lease.
The exact final candidate receives independent PASS review and both public workflows pass.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The installer supplies SpecSwarm and its complete transitive skill-code closure from repository-local files.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No required skill may be reference-only or downloaded from another marketplace.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A new user with a clean Codex home.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: EKG and Slopware ownership and license boundaries are accurate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No upstream material may be misattributed.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Release verification and rollback bind to the exact final correction and protected public baseline.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No stale contract, receipt, comparison SHA, or rollback SHA may govern publication.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: The trusted guard, GitHub workflow, and release operator.

proof_requirements.claim: The transitive skill inventory is complete.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Resolve all skill, hook, script, reference, and package paths and compare hashes.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: No required skill artifact is absent or external-only.

proof_requirements.claim: The offline-style install is complete and functional.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Fresh Z-drive Codex home with network plugin calls disabled
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Install, compare hashes, invoke bridge, inspect hooks, and run tests.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: All skills and hooks install and work without a skill download.

proof_requirements.claim: Attribution and license statements match bundled bytes.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Tracked notices, docs, manifest, and vendored license
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Audit component ownership, versions, source bytes, and licenses.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: EKG owns SpecSwarm/governance; Slopware retains MSW/Hook/Timebox credit and CC BY 4.0.

proof_requirements.claim: Exact review, release verification, and rollback are fail-closed and current.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Clean candidate, signed receipts, guard, GitHub configuration and Actions
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Review exact diff, run verifier adversarial cases, inspect rollback SHA, guarded push, and attest public state.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Only the signed candidate publishes, workflows pass, and rollback preserves a0d2340.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Exact candidate, complete dependency proof, isolated install, tests, attribution, rollback, signed phase chain, and public reconciliation.

stop_conditions: Any dependency remains external-only or uninstalled.
Any attribution, install, test, verifier, guard, workflow, or rollback proof fails.
Any forbidden or unexplained diff, cache, history, or secret appears.
known_discrepancies: The baseline installer omitted SpecSwarm/governance and fetched Slopware packages.
The first correction contract omitted docs/RELEASE.md; its stale rollback SHA would discard the protected public baseline.
